name: Growth
summary: Green and grow, burn to nothing
effects:
Spells from this Rune only effect living things you Touch and in the following ways, depending what they are:
The Target may shed T Strain but, when the Spell ends, must roll as many Chaos Dice, suffering Persistant Strain for each 6 rolled.
It surges to life and takes a form you choose (which must still fit the loose normal range for the plant). Among other uses, these rapid movements can be used to form tendrils which allow you to Interact up to T Meters away using the plant. When the Spell ends, the plant instantly dies and crumbles to dust. Likewise, this robs the plant of any wholesome nutritional value it had.

attrs.description:
Vital. Growth, like all the Runes of Life, is a fleeting glimpse of the majesty of creation. Alone, it often harms as much as helps.

name: Substance
effects:
You transmute up to T Bulk of something you Touch into a different compound. All such changes obey the following laws:
The resultant compound is always less pure than the original. Metal can never become a gem, silver cannot become gold, but any metal can become dirt, and a gem can become gold. This almost directly means that the transmutation depreciates the Value of the product.
The product must be of the same "state" as the ingredient under current conditions. Stone cannot become water, but ice can become some kinds of stone. Relative changes in Hardness should not exceed 2T.
The product is never more "reactive" than the ingredient. Black powder could be made into sand, and acid could become saltwater, but not the inverse. Likewise, the Substance Rune alone cannot make something edible or from something poisonous and the nutritive principle of the product is always less than the ingredient. In the acid example, brackish saltwater can be produced, but not freshwater. Conversely, milk could become water, but not vise versa.

attrs.description:
The Crown Rune of Change. Substance is an extremely abstract but equally vital element of Being.

name: Regeneration
effects:
Touch a Creature, they shed Injuries depending on the amount of Aether spent (in Casting or afterwards with persistent Touch). You may continue to spend Aether for T Rounds thereafter for this purpose.
So, a T6 Regeneration Spell could instantly heal a Minor Injury, and would provide a subsequent 6 Rounds after Casting to supply more Aether for a greater, or additional Injuries. E.G., a Creature with a Minor and Moderate Injury could be fully healed with one T6 Spell followed by 10 more Aether spent.

attrs.description:
The crown Rune of Life. Regeneration is the highest expression of the Vital principle, even alone it has the power to truly mend.
